responsibility: Declares the public storage-layout API implemented in stor-layout.cc. It exposes routines for laying out declarations and types, record-field placement, alignment adjustment, size/position normalization, creation of signed/unsigned/fixed-point type nodes, sizetype initialization, variable-size handling, and mode-selection helpers, providing the shared interface that front ends and middle-end code use to obtain GCC’s canonical object layout decisions.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public storage-layout and type-layout entry points used elsewhere in GCC; unlike gcc/stor-layout.cc, it does not compute field placement, resolve variable/self-referential sizes, or choose concrete access modes for layout.
